title: Lancasters JB670 and LM332
memorial_details:
description: In honour of the two Lancaster Air Crews/ from RAF Elsham Wolds, who lost their lives/ when the aircraft collided over the/ parish of Ulceby on the 16th December 1943,/ Their target was Berlin./ Lancaster JB670 of 103 Squadron/ (Names)/ 
Lancaster LM332 of 576 Squadron/ (Names)/ MAY THEIR MEMORY LIVE FOREVER.
